text.en: 29,536 rape cases were registered in India in 2024.
text.hg: 2024 mein India mein rape ke 29,536 cases register hue.

text.en: In 96.8% of them, the accused was someone the survivor knew.
text.hg: Inme se 96.8% cases mein accused survivor ka jaan-pehchaan wala tha.

text.en: Courts convicted in only 24.4% of rape trials completed in 2024.
text.hg: 2024 mein complete hue rape trials mein sirf 24.4% mein conviction hua.

text.en: 1,85,785 rape cases were waiting for trial at the end of 2024.
text.hg: 2024 ke end mein rape ke 1,85,785 cases trial ke wait mein the.
2024 mein dowry death ke 5,737 cases register hue.

text.en: Of women who sought help after violence, only 6% went to the police.

text.en: 23.3% of women aged 20–24 were married before they turned 18.

text.en: Unsafe abortion causes about 8% of maternal deaths in India.
text.hg: India mein lagbhag 8% maternal deaths unsafe abortion se hoti hain.

text.en: 207 acid attacks were registered in India in 2024.

text.hg: Two-finger test banned hai: ise karne wale doctors misconduct ke doshi hain (Supreme Court, 2022).

text.en: Forced sex by a husband with a wife over 18 is still not 'rape' under Indian law.
text.hg: 18 se zyada umar ki wife ke saath husband ka zabardasti sex Indian law mein ab bhi 'rape' nahi hai.
